country.evidence_quote: Professor Michał Iwaszkiewicz Poznań University of Social Sciences (WSUS) is a private higher education institution offering modern, practice-oriented degree programmes in a friendly and supportive academic environment. The University’s main and only campus is located in Poznań, Poland, at Wilczak 16. Situated in one of the country’s leading academic and business centres, WSUS provides students with access to a vibrant city rich in cultural life, innovation, and professional opportunities.
